name: lazarus
description: Proof-checked historical Ethereum fixtures with exact-request replay, no live fallback, and preservation releases a stranger can check.

interface.shortDescription: Proof-checked historical Ethereum fixtures with exact-request replay, no live fallback, and preservation releases a stranger can check.
interface.longDescription: Lazarus captures the finite historical Ethereum state and exact JSON-RPC exchange one application test needs, checks supported account and storage claims through EIP-1186, and reconstructs a declared receipt trie against the named header's receiptsRoot. Only the scoped consensus receipt payload and log projection enter the proved class; transaction hashes, calls, traces, and unrelated fields remain recorded. Fixtures replay exact requests over loopback with no live fallback. Empty blocks do not yet have a receipt-witness representation.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $lazarus to capture, verify or replay this finite historical Ethereum fixture without a live replay fallback.
